Hi Alice — great to hear the demo resonated. Attaching a compact MAP seed (Google Doc link below) and a one-slide week0 pack. I kept this intentionally short so your execs can scan and your engineers can act.

High level plan (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (kickoff, infra & data connect): quick integration checklist, initial sample runs
- Week 1 (validation): run representative traffic, collect quality samples, latency profiling
- Week 2 (scaling & tuning): batching/kv cache config, throughput stress tests, cost projections
- Week 3 (acceptance & handoff): final acceptance suite, runbook, and rollback plan

Acceptance criteria (compact):
- Functional: model responses meet agreed prompt set benchmarks (precision recall / business metric)
- Performance: p50 latency under 180ms on your ray distribution & p95 under 420ms for 95% of traffic
- Reliability: no data egress beyond configured VPC/VPN and logs available for audit (1 week retention for pilot)
- Operational: integration scripts + a runbook handed over to your SREs

Next steps:
1) I shared the MAP seed as an editable Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xx7_qrSolsticeMAPSeed
2) Week0 slides stub attached (week0-plan-slides.pptx)
3) If procurement wants a short SOW/PO template, loop procurement@solstice.ai and I can get legal to share a template — typical PO lead time for pilots is 7–14 business days.

I've CC'd Marissa (Customer Success) who will own the technical runbook and weekly check-ins. Marissa — can you add a short acceptance test checklist to the GDoc by Monday?

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
